data.title: Triangulation Fraud Shipping Pattern Detection
data.description: Detects orders where the shipping address differs from the billing address and matches known drop-ship or reshipping patterns associated with triangulation fraud. In triangulation fraud, a fraudster lists goods on a marketplace, collects payment from a victim buyer, then purchases the item from a legitimate retailer using stolen payment credentials, shipping directly to the victim. Indicators include shipping to known drop addresses, freight forwarders, or addresses seen across multiple unrelated accounts.

detection.condition: selection and (filter_drop_address or filter_shared_address or filter_velocity)

falsepositives: Legitimate gift orders shipped to recipients at different addresses
Corporate purchasing departments using centralized receiving addresses
Customers shipping to workplace address for package security
